versions.changelog:
- Version updated from 0.1.0 to 0.1.1.
- Documentation files (README.md, SKILL.md) updated; no changes to feature set or logic.
- No new features or functionality were introduced.

Initial release of cn-blog-writing – a skill to assist with writing, editing, and planning Chinese technical blog posts.

- Analyzes user's blog for writing style, topics, and SEO status upon first use.
- Provides sentence rhythm and tone rules to reduce AI-detection features.
- Checks drafts for AI traits and suggests tone/style adjustments.
- Helps plan future blog topics based on gaps, internal linking, and SEO potential.
- Includes a list of banned phrases and formatting practices to ensure natural writing style.
